title: POWR backup: data/sessions.json (dataVersion 2)
description: A JSON array of sessions records, sorted by id. Generated by `pnpm formats:schemas` from the Zod schemas the import uses (packages/formats); do not edit. Rules JSON Schema cannot express are listed in docs/formats/backup-format.md.

instantTz.description: A moment in time: epochMs is milliseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z (UTC), offsetMin the offset from UTC in minutes at that moment, zone the IANA time zone name (for example Europe/Zurich).

localDate.description: A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD in the user's local time zone. It must be a real date (2026-02-30 is rejected).

mass.description: A weight with its unit. Converted to kg, the value lies between -500 and 2000; a negative load is assistance (for example a machine-assisted pull-up).

prescription.description: How an exercise is prescribed, chosen by mode. Ranges are [min, max] with min <= max; RIR (reps in reserve) moves in steps of 0.5.

sessionCore.description: A workout (data name: session) without its undo snapshot; used inside the undo snapshot of a session record.

sessionExercise.description: One exercise of a workout (data name: session) with its planned sets; key is unique within the workout.

versionStamp.description: The engine, rules registry and exercise content versions that produced the record.
